name: Las Preguntas
caption: El Gringo Loco's own Cartel tag team, the SCW Lonestar Tag Team Champions from the federation's own first show until Davey-Boy O'Brien and Keegan took the belts from them at Showdown I.

tenures.role: tag team — SCW Lonestar Tag Team Champions
tenures.source: The federation's own served showdown1.html, billing them at the bell as "the SCW Lonestar Tag Team Champions... Duda y Marca... LAS PREGUNTAS!", led to the ring by El Gringo Loco (unminted); and the federation's own Lonestar Tag Team Title History, served as /promotions/scw-southwestern-2019/archive/lonestartagtitlehistory.html, crediting them with the opening reign (won 18 June 2019, lost 8 December 2019).
tenures.note: Not on the federation's own current roster.html, which reflects a later roster state; recovered entirely from the title history and the Showdown I broadcast. No individual wrestler-application page survives for either Duda or Marca, so neither carries a character_id. Their manager, El Gringo Loco, leader of the in-fiction stable "the Cartel," recurs across nearly every held Rampage broadcast and the Showdown I broadcast but is outside the roster-mint scope for now.

name: The Crusaders
caption: Bishop and Deacon, a silent pair who took their orders from their manager Ezekiel Abraham as the word of God, reached SCW after its signing freeze lifted in December 2019.

identity.note: PCW's Crusaders (2002) were "The Crimson" Thinh Alexander and "Night Shard" Robert Yarney; SCW's own application names Bishop and Deacon, managed by Ezekiel Abraham. Only the team name is shared.

tenures.source: The federation's own tag-team application page (tagapp009.html), its own news page of 12 December 2019 (newsrumors.html) and its own Rampage broadcasts of January 2020.

name: American Revival
caption: Colby Prince and Ryan Paris, back from a year of touring the east coast, Europe and Japan, called out SCW for a tag title shot as American Revival.

tenures.source: The federation's own tag-team application page (tagapp007.html) and its own Rampage broadcasts.

name: Border Control
caption: Agents Lincoln and Washington of Washington, DC, finished SCW opponents with the stereo lariats they called "Welcome to America."

tenures.source: The federation's own tag-team application page (tagapp008.html) and its own Rampage broadcasts.

name: The Masked Brothers
caption: The Masked Maniac and the Masked Wingman, the Masked Bros, worked their way back up SCW's tag rankings while feuding with Sweaty Bling.

tenures.source: The federation's own tag-team application page (tagapp005.html) and its own Rampage broadcasts.

name: Prague Drinking Team
caption: Josef Skala and Jan Bosko of Prague, the Prague Drinking Team, fought in SCW's opening four-way for the first Lonestar Tag Team Championship.

tenures.source: The federation's own tag-team application page (openertagapp02.html) and its own Rampage broadcasts.

name: The Rich Family
caption: Four Dallas Riches, any two of them under Freebird rules, carried Texas's own wrestling legacy into SCW's tag division as the Rich Family.

tenures.source: The federation's own tag-team application page (tagapp004.html) and its own Rampage broadcasts.

name: Sweaty Bling
caption: The Pirate of Bling from Blackpool and Tony Sweat from Miami, Sweaty Bling came to Texas vowing to plunder every tag team for gold.

tenures.source: The federation's own tag-team application page (tagapp002.html) and its own Rampage broadcasts.

name: The Trailer Park Assassinz
caption: Brutalizer and Destruktor of Pine Bluff, Arkansas, billed at a combined 200 pounds, were the Trailer Park Assassinz of SCW's undercard.

tenures.source: The federation's own tag-team application page (tagapp006.html) and its own Rampage broadcasts.

name: 'Nuff Said
caption: Kamikaze Keith and Suicidal Steve of Niagara Falls, 'Nuff Said, wrestled Greco-Roman on SCW's first Rampage.

tenures.source: The federation's own Rampage broadcasts, first on 18 June 2019; its tag-team application page (jobbertagapp003.html) survives blank.
